candidates.title: Plan-gate bypass + PII disclosure: store owner address leaks via pattern documents and /r/maps/ redirect
candidates.description: The public serializer correctly gates the address, but two other public paths bypass the `has_location_map` benefit (Estandar+) and one bypasses even the owner toggle: (1) StorePublicSerializer.get_location_address correctly requires customization.show_location AND profile_has_benefit(store.user,'has_location_map') AND user.address; (2) pattern_render.build_store_context sets address = user.address whenever customization.show_location is true with NO has_location_map check, exposes store_address in the pattern context, and sets store_maps_url = contact_redirect_path(store,'maps') when address is present; _page_flags 'location' likewise keys only on show_location; (3) pattern sources interpolate {{store_address}} directly into served HTML across many designs; data-flag='location' zones hide only on show_location, never on plan; (4) contact_redirect_url kind=='maps' builds https://maps.google.com/?q=<user.address>, <city>, <province> with zero gates, reachable via public_contact which only requires published+unblocked+has_public_link; (5) compounding: show_location defaults True and without has_location_map the customization PATCH discards the field entirely (LOCATION_FIELDS), so lower-plan owners cannot even disable it; (6) user.address is EncryptedCharField — the owner's business domicilio, explicitly treated as plan-gated PII. Net: any anonymous visitor of any published store (including expired/basico plans without has_location_map) obtains the full street address — baked into pattern-document HTML and via GET /api/stores/public/<slug>/r/maps/ -> 302, even when show_location=False. The Vue path is properly gated (location_address -> None).
candidates.root_cause: Plan enforcement for the location benefit exists only in StorePublicSerializer.get_location_address; pattern_render.build_store_context and stores/services/contact.py contact_redirect_url re-derive the address/maps URL from raw user.address + show_location without consulting profile_has_benefit('has_location_map').
candidates.intended_behavior: Every public surface that exposes the owner address or a maps link must require the same effective gate as the serializer: show_location AND has_location_map benefit (and arguably the owner's stored address).

candidates.evidence: Full source chain verified: serializer gate vs ungated pattern_render context vs ungated contact_redirect_url; EncryptedCharField user.address confirmed; show_location default True + write-discard confirmed. No runtime test (source-only audit).
candidates.conditions: Any published+unblocked store whose owner has user.address set and whose plan lacks has_location_map (básico/expired) — the common case. Anonymous access, no auth needed.

execution.observed_result: Source-derived: both paths expose owner.address regardless of plan benefit or show_location=False.

candidates.remediation: In build_store_context require profile_has_benefit(store.user,'has_location_map') for address/store_maps_url and align the 'location' page flag; in contact_redirect_url/public_contact gate kind=='maps' on the same benefit + show_location. Consider a data migration or read-time coercion for stores that saved show_location=True before the benefit existed.

severity.rationale: Unauthenticated PII disclosure (owner business address) on every published store lacking the paid benefit; deterministic, no interaction needed, and the plan gate that was supposed to protect it is bypassed on two independent public paths.
